conclusions: A local 9B model on a $599 Mac Mini outperformed Google's latest Gemini 3.8 Flash cloud model in turn efficiency (4 turns vs 9 turns) when governed by JIT Context OS.
Gemini 3.8 Flash completely failed the task (0/4 passed) when run without JIT in standard conversational chat mode due to Haystack attention degradation.

Local 7B–9B models do not lack code intelligence; they were historically starved or choked by bloated context windows. JIT Context OS unlocks SOTA local autonomous coding at zero cost with absolute privacy.
